name: Redemption
meaning: One of one · when the wood is found
imageAlt: A Redemption Series guitar with a heavily figured, weathered wood body standing under a spotlight
featureAlt: Redemption Series guitar, full length, its reclaimed wood body showing deep grain, cracks and character
summary: Built only from overlooked, reclaimed or passed-over wood — and only when the right piece turns up.
story: Where others see something imperfect, overlooked or disposable, we look again. There may still be beauty written into it.
We don't manufacture imperfections. We don't invent a story. We work with the story already there. Every Redemption guitar is one of one, and it exists only when the right material is found.
